description:
Maintainer, 2026-08-13: "the popup windows on windows is super annoying."

REGRESSION, introduced by 0.1.3 (GH#19, commits f06e642 / 653c22f). Chain is:

1. The daemon is spawned with `DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW`
   (surface/ipc/spawn_sanitizer.rs:163). Correct — but it means the daemon
   process HAS NO CONSOLE.
2. 0.1.3 made network push shell out to the system git binary:
   `subprocess_push` at git/gix_compat.rs:910 does a plain
   `std::process::Command::new("git")` with NO creation flags.
3. On Windows, a console-subsystem child spawned from a parent that has NO
   console gets a BRAND NEW CONSOLE WINDOW allocated for it.
4. The daemon debounces and AUTO-SYNCS. So: one popup window per sync, forever.

Before 0.1.3 push failed fast in-process and never shelled out, so no popups.
We fixed the push and gave the user a strobe light. Paiseh.

Every `std::process::Command` in the crate needs `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` on Windows,
because ANY of them can run under the daemon:
  * git/gix_compat.rs:910          — `git push`  (THE hot one, fires every sync)
  * bootstrap/repo.rs:91           — `jj` detection
  * cli_surface/commands/show.rs:732 — `jj`

`CREATE_NO_WINDOW` (0x08000000) is exactly right here: all three capture
stdout/stderr via `.output()`, so no console is wanted at all. Note this is
DIFFERENT from `DETACHED_PROCESS` — detached is for the long-lived daemon; for a
short-lived child whose output we capture, plain `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` is correct.
Do NOT combine them (`DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW` on a child we then
`.output()` is not what we want).

Implementation: one shared `pub(crate)` helper that takes `&mut Command` and, on
Windows only, sets `.creation_flags(CREATE_NO_WINDOW)` via
`std::os::windows::process::CommandExt`; a no-op on unix. Apply at all three
sites. Do not hand-roll `CreateProcessW` — `.creation_flags` is enough for
`.output()` children, unlike the daemon spawn which needs the full call.

VERIFICATION PROBLEM, be honest about it: the fix lives entirely in
`#[cfg(windows)]` code, which NEVER compiles on Linux, so a typo ships broken.
`rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` + `cargo check --target
x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p kopi-beans` at minimum proves it compiles. Whether the
popups are actually GONE can only be confirmed on the maintainer's Windows box —
that part is human dogfooding, do not claim it verified.
title: kopi-beans: every daemon git push pops a console window on Windows (regression from 0.1.3)
